sources.note: Apple product and platform announcements.

sources.note: Press; a few stories a day. The main feeds.arstechnica.com feed is refused by robots.txt.

sources.note: Press; the feed only carries the latest ten stories.

sources.note: Press; much of it is market commentary, which the writer declines.

sources.name: The Block

sources.name: Meta Newsroom

sources.name: Microsoft Research blog
sources.note: Microsoft Research papers and model releases.

sources.name: Google Keyword blog
sources.note: All of Google's official blog (Android, Pixel, Search), wider than the AI section above; the same post from both feeds is an exact duplicate.

sources.name: Google Cloud blog
sources.note: Google Cloud announcements; the feed's articles live on cloud.google.com.

sources.name: GitHub blog

sources.note: Cloudflare's announcements and incident write-ups.

sources.name: Chainalysis blog
